This module implements a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with Time-To-Live (TTL)

        ttl: Time-to-live in seconds. None means no expiry.
        last_accessed: Timestamp of the last access to this entry.
    """
    key: Any
    value: Any
    created_at: float
    ttl: Optional[float] = None
    last_accessed: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """
        Check if this cache entry has expired based on its TTL.
        
        Returns:
            True if the entry has expired, False otherwise.
        """
        if self.ttl is None:
            return False
        return time.time() > (self.created_at + self.ttl)

        """
        Get the remaining time-to-live for this entry.
        
        Returns:
            Remaining TTL in seconds, or None if no TTL is set.
        """
        if self.ttl is None:
